text:
nina: Heads up from the node onboarding run: occasionally seeing different req_ids for what looks like the same user request and one of the log lines contained a raw email. Repro steps below.

gokul: ack. paste the minimal logs + how the SDK was initialized.

nina: sanitized excerpt from sample app (express + retry middleware):
```
INFO 2026-04-02T09:11:10Z req=aa11 user=ben@example.com event=login.start
INFO 2026-04-02T09:11:11Z req=aa11 event=login.retry attempt=1
ERROR 2026-04-02T09:11:12Z req=bb22 user=ben@example.com event=login.complete error=timeout
```
first two lines look redacted/rooted good, third leaked email and has req=bb22. SDK init in sampleapp:
```
Telemetry.start({ hooks: [attachSpan, redactPII, sampleHook] })
```
looks like the retry middleware re-dispatches the handler which creates a new trace/span and the emitted log escapes the redact hook.

anya: is redactPII synchronous? if it's only wired to attachSpan, a re-dispatch that emits later may bypass it.

gokul: exactly. i suspect hook ordering + re-dispatch path. Add to that, the sampler sometimes drops a span so ordering changes.

nina: i tried a tiny local change in the sampleapp to run redaction on emit (final record) instead of attach:
```js
// quick hack in sampleapp logger
logger.on('record', rec => { if (!rec.__pii_redacted) { redact(rec); rec.__pii_redacted = true } });
```
that fixed the leak in my repro. marking prevents double work.

log-bot: created ticket DE-5340: "node sdk: retry path causes duplicate req_id + missed PII redaction" -> https://jira/redwood/DE-5340

anya: nice. perf concern though if we run redact for every emit. maybe only run emit-time redact when context shows retry happened, or make redact extremely cheap by early-check marker.

infra: quick question for SDK owners: do mobile + native shims have the same attach-vs-emit hook behavior? we should scope fix narrowly if mobile unaffected.

gokul: checked earlier -- mobile shims do redaction at output pipeline (emit) already, so unaffected. this is purely node express retry re-dispatch pattern.

nina: proposed plan: (1) add integration test simulating express retry re-dispatch asserting single stable req id and no PII in logs; (2) change Node SDK redact hook to default to emit-stage redaction, while keeping attach-stage opt-in for legacy apps; (3) add cheap marker __pii_redacted to avoid extra CPU; (4) publish 0.12.4-canary and monitor error/PII dashboards for regressions.

anya: i'll own the test. gokul, can you draft the PR that moves redact to emit with a flag to opt back to attach? include microbenchmark to show perf delta.

gokul: yep. will add the microbench and include docs note in migration guide. also will add a unit that simulates double-emits to ensure marker prevents double-redact.

nina: thanks team. adding links to repro logs and a short snippet to DE-5340. :thumbsup:
